findings.summary: Audit log rows have no row header identifying each event.
findings.fix: If Date and time identifies each event, mark each row’s date/time cell as <th scope="row"> while retaining the column header.
findings.evidence: Audit log data rows begin with <td> for created_at and contain no row-scoped <th>.

findings.summary: Keyboard-focusable table scroll wrappers lack a region role for their accessible labels.
findings.fix: Add role="region" to each focusable .admin-table-scroll wrapper so its existing aria-label names the scrollable region.
findings.evidence: The wrappers have tabindex="0" and aria-label but no explicit semantic role.

findings.summary: The horizontal-scroll containers have no visible cue that additional columns may be off-screen.
findings.fix: Provide a visible horizontal-scroll hint or other clear overflow cue for tables that require scrolling; do not rely on the non-visible aria-label as the visual instruction.
findings.evidence: .admin-table-scroll enables overflow-x: auto but defines no visible scroll hint or overflow indicator.

passed: Admin, user, academic, and enrollment-summary tables have captions and explicit column scopes.
Admin, user, academic, department, program, section, and enrollment-summary rows use row headers.
Table scroll wrappers are keyboard-focusable and have overflow-x: auto.
notes: Static source review; rendered behavior and assistive-technology output were not runtime-tested.
